purpose: Fail-closed integrity contract for promoting a reviewed release across candidate status, canonical reviewed ledger, certification receipt and independent review decision.
managedAppRule: An app becomes promotion-managed once it has any record in review-candidates-v1. Legacy reviewed apps with no candidate history remain valid until their first candidate is created.
requiredPromotionState: Exactly one accepted candidate for the app must match the app's current canonical reviewed-ledger identity.
That accepted candidate must have exactly one accepted review-decision record.
The app's current certification receipt must exactly match the accepted candidate and canonical reviewed-ledger identity.
No other accepted candidate for the app may point at a different reviewed identity.
A pending candidate may not already equal the app's current reviewed identity.
atomicity: Candidate status, canonical reviewed ledger, certification receipt and review decision are treated as one promotion unit by CI.
A partial promotion is invalid even when each changed file is individually well-formed.
Repository merge atomicity is supplied by the reviewed pull-request commit; this contract verifies the resulting repository state, not a distributed transaction.
nonClaims: This contract does not make the review-decision ledger a badge authority.
Certification authority remains the canonical reviewed ledger plus exact certification receipt, subject to current revocation state.
Legacy apps without review-candidate history are not retroactively required to manufacture candidate records.
